Six model Peru-Chile Undercurrent sections retain source-selected2cm/s poleward isotach depths: Punta Falsa240m, Chimbote280m, Callao310m, Pisco470m, San Juan550m and Arica620m, with section latitudes and a shared source branch sequence ID.

The six-depth sequence is spatial and modeled. It does not inherit separate potential-vorticity prediction values marked by stars in the paper, establish seasonal extrema, or supply whole-Humboldt route geometry.

Offshore Peru Oceanic Current at least500m retains inclusive lower-bound semantics, calibrated/interpolated SADCP reconstruction and uneven2008–2012 survey support. It is distinct from PCC, PCUC and CPDCC, and not joined to the earlier model dimensions.
Oyashio shallower than2000m retains a strict upper bound for summer/fall flow southeast of Hokkaido, without arbitrary months or a numeric winter bottom from qualitative surface-to-bottom language.

The retained inclusive reach is explicitly inferred from that component; no strict greater-than sign is imported from indexed publisher text. Deep recirculation and eddy influence remain explicit, and no inheritance into North Pacific Current or the excluded offshore Oyashio Front occurs.
